items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: But a friend of mine talked to a club owner, the friend is Don Piestrup

ctx.x: So it kind of runs by itself now, but it took — the first few years was really hairy. Because guys would call up at the last minute, “oh I can’t make it.” But it was all that, the visions of doing all the phoning and the organizing and finding a place to rehearse that kept me from doing it before. But a friend of mine talked to a club owner, the friend is Don Piestrup, he’s a writer too. He talked to the owner of Donte’s out in North Hollywood and said, “Why don’t you get Bill a Sunday night, every Sunday night…
Yeah, 1960, “Bill Holman’s Great Big Band.” Was “Big Band In Jazz Orbit” ’58, was that one of your first records under your own name?
